content.text: No restrictive covenant exists; the agreement affirmatively disclaims exclusivity.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: A full sweep of the Agreement (single Preamble section, p0000–p0074) reveals no non-compete, field-of-use, territory or "shall not compete/develop/market" covenant binding AP. To the contrary, Section 1 (p0001) expressly disclaims exclusivity and confirms AP may offer Inventory via other agents or sell to third parties, and the Kubient licence in Section 2 (p0002) is non-exclusive. The only restrictions on AP are ordinary licence-use limits in Section 6(a) (no reverse engineering, no third-party access to the Service, no service-bureau resale of the Service), which govern use of Kubient's own platform rather than restraining AP's businesses, products or purchasing freedom, and Section 12 confidentiality expressly preserves independent development. This meets the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer), so no redline is proposed.
